title: MSA/DPA counterproposal templates & liability-escalation matrix for pricing bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Solutions Engineering are encountering long lead times when negotiating MSA/DPA liability and indemnity exceptions for bundled pricing offers. Legal review and engineering sign-off for indemnity/escrow concessions is inconsistent, which causes delays and revenue slippage for enterprise deals.

Goal: Create a set of structured, tiered counterproposal templates (MSA & DPA clauses) mapped to pricing bundle tiers and a clear liability escalation matrix that can be surfaced in the sales quoting tool. Deliverables should allow ~80% of common redlines to be auto-suggested and fast-tracked with documented approval thresholds, plus a playbook for exceptions that must be escalated to Legal/Head of Revenue.

Scope: Templates for indemnity, liability cap, carve-outs, escrow/third-party IP, audit rights, and standard data processing carve-outs. The escalation matrix must map SSQ scores and ARR bands to: auto-approve, director approval, legal review, security review, or executive sign-off. Integrations: Sales quoting UI (internal), Legal intake (Jira/Linear routing), and the contract assembly flow (DocuSign/Confluence template store).

Out of scope: Changes to pricing tiers themselves or re-negotiation of existing committed contracts (those are handled case-by-case).
acceptance_criteria: A set of 6 MSA/DPA counterproposal templates (plain-text + redlineable clauses) covering common indemnity/liability scenarios
Escalation matrix mapping SSQ score ranges and ARR bands to approval routing (documented in Confluence)
Sales quoting UI mock showing inline suggestion copy and 'auto-apply' thresholds
Legal sign-off received on templates (email + Confluence approval stamp)
Playbook with step-by-step escalation runbook and contact list published
Pilot applied to 10 active deals via Solutions Engineering with measurable reduction in negotiation time (target: 40% faster approvals)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly permissive auto-approve thresholds could expose us to outsized liability. Mitigation: conservative defaults with explicit CFO/legal approval for high-ARR customers.
Risk: Sales may misuse 'auto-apply' and accelerate risky exceptions. Mitigation: telemetry and gating — flag when applied and require post-apply audit for first 30 deals.
Risk: Inconsistent SSQ scoring across partners. Mitigation: canonicalize SSQ mapping and require Security review for scores flagged as ambiguous.
